exposure: Operative hysteroscopy prior to first frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET)
cohort: 879 patients (879 cycles) who underwent their first FET at the Reproductive Medicine Center of the Second Affiliated Hospital of the Naval Medical University between July 1, 2021, and May 31, 2024, categorized into those with suspected uterine cavity lesions who underwent hysteroscopy and those without who did not.
finding: Performing operative hysteroscopy before the first frozen-thawed embryo transfer in patients with suspected uterine cavity lesions significantly improved both clinical pregnancy rates and live birth rates.
